training_policy: Fresh pinned upstream opt-dist rustc/Cargo/rustdoc/LLVM training, Microsoft link/lib, static-LLVM relink repair only; stop after LLVM profile generation. Freeze the repaired profile hash before either comparison build. Final builds use official rustc/Cargo/rustdoc profiles.
common_inputs: Pinned Rust 1.99.1/LLVM 23.1.1, clang-cl 20.1.3, Microsoft link/lib, official rustc and rustdoc profiles; Cargo shares official rustc profile; Rust thin-local, LLVM ThinLTO off
primary_endpoint: Sum of five original offline native Cargo compilation commands per block
shared_replay_inputs: Official Rust 1.99.1 Cargo and byte-identical official native standard libraries
order: Training first, then fresh official and repaired builds at identical source paths; alternating replay order
correctness: Unmodified upstream extracted-distribution tests for both compilers; original native correctness tests after each warmup; NTFS correctness TEMP/TMP
aggregation: Mean of three measured rounds per compiler; paired round range, not independent-VM confidence intervals
exclusions: Exclude preregistered warmup, setup, fetching, correctness; reject failures, incomplete matrices or changed common inputs
scope: One matched build pair and one dedicated x64 host; only final LLVM profile differs. Training cost recorded separately, not a matched fresh-training CI cost comparison.
